title: SplitWalls Command
description: Split each wall record that holds more than one straight run into one record per run, with the same union, so a click picks one wall. A corner goes to the longer run, then the one facing north or south; a tee stays with the through run. Each opening goes to the piece that holds it, and that piece is rebuilt with its openings cut; the old record is deleted. A record the split refuses (a curve, an opening across two pieces) stays whole and is listed in refused. One undo. Id omitted splits every whole record. Refuses X-EXIST.

id.description: Wall GUID: split that record only. Omit to split every whole record.
